reviewer.independence: Did not author controller code; authored three requested lifecycle regression cases after reporting reproduced findings. Separate diff/security review must cover those tests.

activeRoute: E4 / PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_ISOLATION / restore the stopped autopilot while checkpointing unfinished product as IN_PROGRESS
scope: Usage-limit recovery controller, bounded evidence binding, undeployed product checkpoint, original scope/budget preservation, reconcile/arm/run lifecycle; not product acceptance or deployment authorization beyond existing owner request.

findings.summary: Checkpoint completion was rejected as NO_PRODUCT_CODE_PROGRESS because the recovered worker used checkpoint HEAD as its progress base.
findings.evidence: Isolated pre-fix reproduction returned NO_PRODUCT_CODE_PROGRESS. Latest controller carries recovery_before through reconcile/arm and applies it exactly once. Real worker regressions accept docs-only finalization of existing product code and reject a later docs-only iteration.

findings.summary: A persistent recovery_kind marker would prevent a later separately authorized fresh run after the original deadline.
findings.evidence: Recovery preservation applies only to RECONCILED/ARMED states and active markers clear on the first accepted completion. Finite-budget lifecycle regression reaches original max_iterations=3 after one resumed completion and accepts a fresh explicit arm after the old deadline.

checks.command: Bounded read of selected status fields and final JSONL event only
checks.result: FAILED/CODEX_EXIT_1; child_pid=0; accepted_iterations=2; E4/CURRENT_AUTHORIZED_SCOPE; terminal turn.failed contains exact usage-limit cause; receipt absent

checks.command: Hash local candidate, deployed webapp and git before:webapp without printing content
checks.result: Deployed bytes equal original pre-failure commit and differ from pending candidate

checks.command: systemctl show relay-fastapi.service, exchange-bot.service, nginx.service (separate read-only calls)

limitations: This review does not accept unfinished payment UI or claim its end-to-end usability.
Initial system/root/relay Python environments lacked pytest; existing /opt/lumi/venv supplied the test environment.
A nested sandboxed systemctl read was denied; the required read-only calls succeeded using approved escalation.
No production state, service lifecycle, credentials or Git mutations were performed by this reviewer.
